build_note: Listed 6-4, 205 lb, No. 2 (Basketball-Reference; Wikipedia); 6-5.5 wingspan at the 2023 draft combine (HoopsMatic)
story: Down 11 in the third and 86–85 late, the Warriors went ahead on Brandin Podziemski's three with 2:38 left and held on, 88–87.
aria: Animated Short: Brandin Podziemski's 3-pointer off Gui Santos' pass with 2:38 left that turned an 86–85 deficit into an 88–86 Warriors lead in their 88–87 win over Boston. An original illustration, not traced from footage, not to scale.
